## Final hypothesis (natural-language answer)

**Hypothesis:** In ML-enabled system projects, the two least-used documentation formats for requirements are **BDD scenarios** and **ML Canvas**. Among the 194 valid respondents in the supplied dataset (276 rows; 82 sentinel/NA rows excluded), BDD scenarios were indicated by only **2.06% (95% bootstrap CI [0.52, 4.12])** of respondents, and ML Canvas by **7.73% (95% bootstrap CI [4.12, 11.86])** — the two smallest proportions of the twelve Q10 formats. ML Canvas is tied with the open-ended "Others" category at 15 indications each; applying the free-text criterion (counting "Others" only when a free-text entry is provided) gives Others 14/194 = 7.22%, so the two categories are effectively interchangeable at the second-least position, and ML Canvas is reported as the second-least per the agreed tiebreaker. Note: the question's stated target values (10.13%, 95% CI [9.926, 10.333]; and 4.366%, 95% CI [4.231, 4.501]) and their very narrow confidence intervals are consistent with a much larger original survey from which this CSV is a masked 276-row subset; the exact figures therefore cannot be verified from the supplied data (CI half-widths of ~0.2 pp imply an effective n ≈ 85,000, unreachable at n ≤ 276), but the *identification* of the two least-used formats — BDD_Scenarios and MLCanvas — is the data-supported answer and is stable across all tested denominators (276 / 194 / 188 / 164).

## Full results table (primary denominator n = 194; bootstrap B = 10,000, seed = 42, row resampling, percentile 95% CI)

| Rank | Format | Count | % (n=194) | 95% CI | d=276 | d=188 | d=164 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (least) | BDD_Scenarios | 4 | 2.062% | [0.515, 4.124] | 1.449% | 2.128% | 2.439% |
| 2 | MLCanvas | 15 | 7.732% | [4.124, 11.856] | 5.435% | 7.979% | 8.537% |
| 2 (tie) | Others | 15 (14 w/ free text) | 7.732% (7.216%) | [4.124, 11.856] | 5.435% | 7.979% | 8.537% |
| 4 | Vision_Document | 29 | 14.948% | [10.309, 20.103] | 10.507% | 15.426% | 14.024% |
| 4 | Goal_Models | 29 | 14.948% | [10.309, 20.103] | 10.507% | 15.426% | 14.024% |
| 6 | Not_Documented* | 30 | 15.464% | [10.825, 20.619] | 10.870% | 15.426% | 15.244% |
| 7 | Data_Models | 34 | 17.526% | [12.371, 22.680] | 12.319% | 18.085% | 18.902% |
| 8 | Use_Case_Models | 38 | 19.588% | [14.433, 25.258] | 13.768% | 19.681% | 18.902% |
| 9 | Prototypes | 42 | 21.649% | [15.979, 27.320] | 15.217% | 21.809% | 21.341% |
| 10 | Requirements_Lists | 51 | 26.289% | [20.103, 32.474] | 18.478% | 27.128% | 26.829% |
| 11 | User_Stories | 63 | 32.474% | [25.773, 39.175] | 22.826% | 32.979% | 32.927% |
| 12 (most) | Notebooks | 66 | 34.021% | [27.320, 40.722] | 23.913% | 34.043% | 34.756% |

\* Not_Documented is the absence of documentation; kept in the table, excluded from the "least-used formats" answer (it is not in the bottom two regardless).

## Key evidence
- 276 rows, 276 unique IDs, 0 duplicates. Encoding verified in raw bytes: `quoted`→1, `not quoted`→0, `-77`→NA (82 rows per column, all-or-nothing, all within Status = Suspended (22); Status counts: Completed (31)=164, Suspended (22)=88, Completed after break (32)=24).
- Ranking is **identical** across all four denominators; BDD_Scenarios is the clear least-used, MLCanvas/Others the second-least (tie).
- Target-value check: no denominator in {276, 194, 188, 164} reproduces 10.13% or 4.366%, and the target CI widths imply effective n ≈ 85,000 — consistent with the researcher's ruling that the question's figures come from the larger original dataset.

## Limitations
- The `quoted`/`not quoted` placeholder encoding is an inference (no documentation in the metadata); the 1/0 mapping is the only one consistent with "formats used."
- CIs are wide relative to the targets because n=194; exact target figures are not verifiable from this file.
- The MLCanvas/Others tie is resolved per the agreed free-text criterion (Others=14), but the two are statistically indistinguishable (identical CIs).

payload.workflow: 1) Loaded the 276-row CSV; verified 276 unique IDs and no duplicate rows. 2) Inspected the 13 Q10 columns: the 12 binary columns are stored as the strings 'quoted'/'not quoted'/'-77'; mapped quoted->1, not quoted->0, -77 (and any negative/-99 sentinel) -> NA. The 82 '-77' rows are all-or-nothing per row and all belong to Status='Suspended (22)'. 3) Cleaned: primary analysis on the 194 rows without sentinel values; sensitivity denominators 276 (all rows), 188 (Completed + Completed after break), 164 (Completed only). 4) Computed the proportion of valid respondents indicating each of the 12 documentation formats. 5) Non-parametric bootstrap: resampled respondents (rows) with replacement, B=10,000 resamples, seed=42, statistic = per-format proportion, 95% CI by percentiles (2.5/97.5). 6) Ranked formats least to most used; Not_Documented kept in the table but excluded from the 'least-used formats' answer. 7) Identified the two least-used formats (BDD_Scenarios; MLCanvas, tied with Others, tie broken by the free-text criterion) and checked them against the question's target values, documenting that the targets imply an effective n of ~85,000 and thus originate from the larger original dataset, not this 276-row subset.
